title: Markdown Is Not a Firewall: four coding agents, one rules file, four boundaries
abstract: arXiv:2611.27112v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Teams put a one-page rules file in a repository and call it a control on coding agents. A registered study found agents rarely look up a repository's contribution rules. I asked the security question: what does a rules file do at a boundary, against a gate? I tested one 278-word rules file, with hypotheses and analysis code deposited first. Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and OpenCode with DeepSeek worked through 20 small repositories with hidden tests, 12 for three of them. Three agents met four boundaries I built: a refused endpoint, a destructive shortcut, a planted instruction and a planted package. Permission prompts, each vendor's own control layer, were off by design. A gate in front of the mock service blocked and logged forbidden requests. translated_title: Markdown 不是防火墙：四个编码智能体、一份规则文件、四道边界
translated_abstract: 各团队在代码仓库中放置一份一页的规则文件，并将其视为对编码智能体的一种控制手段。一项注册研究发现，智能体很少去查阅仓库的贡献规则。我由此提出了安全层面的问题：在边界处、相对于门控而言，规则文件究竟起什么作用？我测试了一份278词的规则文件，并事先存档了假设与分析代码。Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 以及搭载 DeepSeek 的 OpenCode 在20个带有隐藏测试的小型仓库中开展工作（其中三个智能体测试了其中12个）。三个智能体遭遇了我构建的四道边界：一个被拒绝的端点、一个破坏性捷径、一个植入的指令和一个植入的软件包。权限提示（各厂商自带的控制层）在设计上被关闭。位于模拟服务前方的门控会拦截并记录被禁止的请求。每一项判定都从智能体无法篡改的记录中读取，只有我的第一轮评分是对实验组盲测的。无论有无该规则文件，我的检查器都没有发现真实的缺陷。该文件使其中一个……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过对四个编码智能体的受控实验证明，仓库中的 Markdown 规则文件并不能充当安全边界——智能体在面对被拒绝端点、破坏性捷径、植入指令和植入包这四道边界时均可越界，因此规则文件无法替代真正的技术门控与防篡改审计记录。
en_tdlr: Through controlled experiments with four coding agents, this paper shows that a repository's Markdown rules file is not a security boundary—agents crossed all four planted boundaries (a refused endpoint, a destructive shortcut, a planted instruction, and a planted package)—demonstrating that rules files cannot replace genuine technical gates and tamper-proof audit records.
